key_insight: The paper connects data-driven and theoretical turbulence closures for stratified ocean flows to better model unresolved mesoscale eddies and their feedback on the resolved circulation.
engineering_relevance: Improved closure models can make ocean and climate simulations more accurate and computationally feasible by representing subgrid eddy effects without fully resolving them.
method: Compare a range of theoretical and data-driven mesoscale closure formulations.
Use analytical analysis to identify relationships between the closures.
Apply data-driven methods to bridge machine-learning approaches with fluid-dynamics theory.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports a comparative study of closure models and their connections, using analytical and data-driven evaluation rather than a single new simulation benchmark.
watch_item: Closure performance may be sensitive to the stratified, rotating Boussinesq setting, so transferability to other flows or parameter regimes should be checked carefully.
paper_title: Towards bridging the gap between data-driven and theoretical turbulence closures in stratified flows
